content: The official 24/7 league is currently led by Timmy - Top 50, which holds the highest realized PnL (+$49.29) and cleanest operational telemetry. Cosmo & Wanda - Top 50 sits second nominally but carries significant open-trade risk with roughly $39 in unrealized losses and a post-restart tape that has been silent since June 9. The incumbent champion, Cosmo & Wanda - Top 20, remains under severe pressure with equity below par, nearly $59 in unrealized drawdown across five open positions, and no new trades since June 8. Timmy - Top 20 is slightly underwater with negative realized alpha, reinforcing a clear theme that breadth in the Top 50 universe is outperforming the concentrated Top 20 scope for both strategy families. The central tension is between strong closed-trade win rates—particularly the 100% closed rates for both C&W variants—and the structural inability to defend those gains through hold management and timely exits.
